## Rule

**`out[r,c] = in[r,0] if in[r,c]==5 else in[r,c]`** — every gray (color-5) cell takes the
color of column 0 of its own row; everything else passes through. Corpus-proven
**200,000/200,000 exact** + officials 265/265 (`prototypes/study_corpus_task312.py`,
`prototypes/check_officials_task312.py`).

Corpus/officials facts (2026-06-07):
- ALL grids are exactly **12×12**, in_shape == out_shape (200k corpus + 265 officials).
- Color-5 never in col 0 anywhere; **officials have 5s at col 1** (4 cells) though the
  200k generator corpus has none before col 2 — §GENERATOR-INVARIANT doctrine live here.
- Color-5 never survives to the output. Col-0 row colors include 0 (bg) — bg is a valid
  replacement color (one-hot ch0=1 written inside active area, decodes correctly).
- CLASS-CHECK: LIVE = 100% on 20k truth → clean class; standard gates (100% truth +
  byte-equal ab) apply.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
pred = np.where(in_idx == 5, in_idx[:, :, 0:1], in_idx)   # index space, per pair
```

### CURRENT BEST - v7 single-Einsum color-map contraction (cost 570 = 0 mem + 570 params)

Builder `prototypes/build_task312_v4.py` (build_v7) -> `prototypes/task312_v7.onnx`; staged at
`staged_submits/task312_rankcut_cost570/` (sha256 D6A0ACB72238A23D...).

```
output = Einsum('v,bkhv,kt,ct,dt,bchw->bdhw',
                e0[30], input, U[10,18], V[10,18], W[10,18], input)
```

The rule IS a per-row color map: out = P_h(incolor), P_h = BANK[col0color(h)] with
BANK[k,c,d] = (c≠5 ? δ(c,d) : δ(d,k)). The col0color selector rides INSIDE the contraction
(e0 picks column 0 of the second free `input` operand) — no Gather, no materialized P, no
intermediates: input ×2 free, output free ⇒ **memory ZERO**. BANK is CP-factored
Σ_t U[k,t]V[c,t]W[d,t] with T=18 over {0,+1,-1}; the signed construction folds one
identity-color slot into the c=5 identity block. The effective BANK remains exact 0/1
(`assert np.array_equal` in the builder; derivation in `Logs/research/R2_selector_bank_rank.md`).
The only cancellation is bounded integer cancellation inside the selector bank contraction.

Gates (2026-06-07): visible 265/265 PASS · truth --full 200,000/200,000 ·
ab --full 200,265/200,265 byte-equal (0 div) vs submission.zip LIVE ·
`score_network_v2` = (0, 0, 570); gate-5 real-input profile `static=570 profile=570`.
Static shapes throughout (§39 exact). Pairwise-reduction
internals stay tiny with the operand order as written (e0×input → [1,10,30]; ×U/V/W →
[1,30,·,·]; ×input → output); ORT executed 200k+ pairs in the gates without latency issues.

Risk ladder (captain picks): v7 570 (6-operand signed CP einsum) -> v5 600 (6-operand 0/1 CP)
-> v4 1,030 (4-operand, dense BANK)
→ v6 2,201 (3-operand class, #74 grader-VERIFIED) → v2 2,777 (no einsum at all).

Divergence classes vs LIVE (all unreachable — corpus + officials are exactly 12×12):
einsum rungs map EVERY cell through P_h, so on a hypothetical >12-wide grid they recolor
5s at w≥12 where LIVE zeroes; Where rungs (v1-v3) pass those cells through unmodified.
Byte-equal holds on all 200,265 tested pairs for every rung.

The col-1..11 cond crop is **provably safe, not a corpus bet**: a 5 at (r,0) would replace
with `in[r,0]` = itself → fixed point → masking col 0 off is identity-equivalent. Verified
off-distribution by `prototypes/probe_col0_five_task312.py` (202 adversarial grids with 5s
forced into col 0: v1 ≡ LIVE decoded-equal). The sibling needs no argument at +60.

## Cost analysis

LIVE paid for (a) a charged F32 12×12 10-channel crop (5,760 B) + F16 recast (2,880 B)
because it processed in one-hot space at crop scale, and (b) a charged 2,880 B Where result
that it then padded (the pad target `output` is the only free tensor — #67). v1 inverts the
structure: keep the 10-channel tensor = `input` (free), lift the Where to full 30×30 so its
result IS `output` (free), and pay only for the tiny cond chain + the col-0 slice.

Where-family memory audit (superseded, kept as the copy-semantics reference): cond 900 +
cond-build 660 + col0 1,200 = 2,760, each term proven minimal; params 17/15. The
contraction family obsoletes the whole audit: when the final einsum REGENERATES every cell
from free operands (input ×2, output), memory is ZERO and the only cost is the map encoding
(params). 12,211 -> 2,777 (Where era) -> 570 (contraction era) in one session.

## Floor proof v2 (post-#68-ADDENDUM, 2026-06-07 — the Where-family floor FELL here)

**Fall record (kept one paragraph, per #68 "floors are formulation-relative"):** the
2,775 Where-family floor was formally intact *within its enumeration* — and the
enumeration was missing the CONTRACTION-final + params-only class. The "passthrough
theorem" (final op must consume `input` directly) silently assumed the output had to be
COPIED; the #65 question — is the output FULLY-GENERATED? — flips it: this output is a
per-row color map of the input (identity ∈ the map), so a contraction can REGENERATE
every cell from free operands and the else-branch buys nothing. 2,775 -> 570 (4.9x), same
session, zero grinding. Generalization: any "passthrough" that is really
identity-within-a-map is contraction-expressible.

**Current best = 570** (v7: memory 0, params 570 = e0 30 + U/V/W 3×180, T=18 exact signed CP).
Within-class residuals, priced:
- **Exact CP rank of BANK**: matricization bound gives rank ≥10 ⇒ theoretical params
  ≥ 330+30 = 360 (T=10). R2 found T=18 by a signed {0,+1,-1} construction that merges
  one identity-color term into the c=5 identity block, with byte-equal full-corpus gates.
  Ranks 10..17 remain OPEN: flattening does not kill them. CP-SAT IS now available locally
  (ortools in .venv) but T=17 signed timed out UNKNOWN at 1930s with no certificate (see
  rework round 2026-06-12); ALS proved incapable of exact integer CP here.
- **e0 [30]**: pinned — the only in-contraction column-0 selector (einsum contracts, never
  indexes).
- **Owner point 3 (shift-as-contraction 'bchw,wv->bchv')**: a dense w-selector [30,30] =
  900 params only ROUTES positions and still needs the 5-detect; the BANK fusion already
  reads col0 inside the same contraction for 30 params. Subsumed, strictly worse.

### Rank-cut rework round (2026-06-12, rework-worker-312 under reviewer-312)

Goal: drop T below 18 (T=17→540, ... T=13→420) by finding an exact integer CP witness
over signed alphabets. Two new methods run (reviewer-mandated). **Outcome: no witness at
any T; floor reaffirmed at 570.** Best stays v7 rank-18 (prototypes/task312_v7.onnx,
sha256 d6a0acb7…; archived at staged_submits/_shipped_archive_20260607/task312_rankcut_cost570/).

**Method 1 — ALS (NEW, prototypes/als_rank_search.py).** Implemented continuous regularized
ALS on Khatri-Rao unfoldings (`scipy.linalg.lstsq`, ridge λ=1e-3) → round to the integer
alphabet → greedy single-entry integer coordinate-descent polish toward exact. Verified the
unfold/einsum orientation is correct (seeded with the true v7 V,W it recovers U exactly).
Result: **ALS fails even on the KNOWN-FEASIBLE T=18** (200 restarts, best |rec−bank|=88 of
100) — projection to the {−1,0,1} alphabet destroys the near-perfect continuous fit
(continuous fiterr ≈0.4 → rounded err ≈90). This is the textbook failure of round-after-ALS
for constrained-alphabet exact integer CP; it is not a tuning gap. Per-T attempt counts (all
`found:false`):

| T | alphabet | restarts | best int err |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 18 (sanity, KNOWN feasible) | {−1,0,1} | 200 | 88 |
| 17 | {−1,0,1} | 250 | 90 |
| 17 | {−2..2} | 200 | 90 |
| 16 | {−1,0,1} | 220 | 89 |
| 15 | {−1,0,1} | 220 | 80 |
| 14 | {−1,0,1} | 220 | 86 |
| 13 | {−1,0,1} | 220 | 89 |

**Method 2 — long CP-SAT (tools/scripts/task312_rank_cpsat.py).** T=17 signed {−1,0,1},
1900s budget, 16 workers, log_search_progress. Model: 184,808 vars / 278,364 constraints
after presolve; full search with 13 subsolvers + 6 shared-tree workers. **Result: status
UNKNOWN at walltime 1928.9s** (cpsat_T17_signed.json) — neither a feasible rank-17 witness
nor an infeasibility certificate within budget. No ONNX emitted. Subsolvers each ran ~29.4
min; shared-tree closed only 1/3 of its root branches — the signed problem is genuinely hard
and does NOT close in 1900s, consistent with the earlier R4 timeouts.

**Decision-rule outcome:** T=17 produced no exact witness after ≥200 ALS restarts (450 total
across two alphabets) AND one 1930s seeded CP-SAT run → **floor reaffirmed at 570; not
descending further.** Ranks 13..17 remain formally OPEN (no infeasibility certificate exists
for signed alphabets — the CP-SAT UNKNOWN is a timeout, not a proof). Reopening requires a
fundamentally stronger exact-integer tool (e.g. a longer/seeded CP-SAT with a custom rank-17
warm-start hint, an SMT/MIQCP backend, or an exact symbolic CP routine) — ALS is ruled out as
incapable here. Artifacts: prototypes/als_*.out, prototypes/cpsat_T17_signed.{json,log}.

## Don't-do log

- **Don't process in one-hot space at crop scale** (LIVE's structure): any 10-channel
  12×12 view costs 5,760 B F32 / 2,880 B F16 charged — the whole game is keeping the
  10-channel tensor = `input` (free) and the select result = `output` (free, #67).
- **Don't crop the cond to the corpus's col-2..11 extent**: officials have 5s at col 1
  (4 cells) — §GENERATOR-INVARIANT vs OFFICIALS-QUIRK. Col-0 exclusion is safe (fixed-point
  algebra, probe-verified); col-1 exclusion is NOT.
- **Don't try row-cropping the cond**: 5s span rows 0..11 in both corpus and officials.
- **Don't reach for Equal-tail / OneHot / idx-canvas here**: every channel-collapse route
  costs ≥3,600 B (or 2,016 sep-Conv) before the rule logic even starts. (The contraction
  family avoids materializing ANY canvas — that's why it wins, not a cheaper collapse.)
- **Don't trust a "passthrough theorem" when the output is FULLY-GENERATED-expressible**
  (#65): if every output cell is a map of input cells (identity included), a multi-operand
  Einsum-as-output regenerates everything from free operands and copy-based floors do not
  bind. This exact blind spot cost 2,775->570 here. Ask the #65 question FIRST.
- **Don't fear >3-operand einsums reflexively**: ORT executed the 6-operand v7 over 200k+
  gate pairs cleanly (and task304 ran 9 operands). DO order operands smallest-first so
  pairwise L2R reduction stays tiny; signed cancellation is acceptable only when the
  effective bank is exact and full-corpus byte-equal.
- ~~Don't chase the opset-18 Pad-axes −2 params~~ **FLIPPED 2026-06-07**: owner authorized
  the risk tier; v3 (opset 18, 2,775) is staged with full gold gates as the floor rung. The
  conservative opset-13 v2 (2,777) stays staged beside it — captain picks the tier.
- **Don't make X (col0) F16/u8**: Where requires X,Y same dtype and Y=input is F32; casting
  input costs 9,000+ B. Don't slice col0 at h=12 and pad (480+1,200 > 1,200).
